author: Acceqted
body:
{tag=58dd0736137542fbacbb8871f871e586}

Hey there,
Folks.

Players name: benaye
Rule Broken: D1: Do not encourage "flame wars" or other inflammatory discussions
D4: Arguments with the intention of humiliating or casting bad light on certain individuals or groups

Evidence: If you are to look at not only recent posts but old posts, his threads almost always turn out into a flame war or heated discussion and have little to no purpose of them.  He continues to create these threads running off of "Avicus is dying, so why not make a joke of it". I wouldn't want that going around my server if I wasn't in charge. I personally feel after the many warnings given to him, he should be permanently forum banned as soon as possible. He is a toxic, arrogant pain in the arse to this community and serves no purpose here.

Anything else?: Nope, thanks in advance!
